messages.subject: Very long command lines
parts:
Hi I am creating some lectures(beamer slides) in .Rmd format using RStudio.
The problem is that some of R commands are long and do not show fully in Beamer slide.

I have tried to edit R chunks like some examples I checked in Google kind of...

```{r tidy=TRUE,highlight=TRUE,tidy.opts=list(blank=FALSE, width=60)}

but still same result.

Is it still possible to manage this or I have to switch back in normal latex where I can use packages like spverbatim etc

Thanx

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Very long command lines
parts:
